label: Aberration
description: A volatility indicator similar to Keltner Channels.

label: Archer Moving Averages Trends (AMAT)
description:
The Archer Moving Averages Trends indicator identifies trend direction by comparing
fast and slow moving averages. It generates long and short run signals based on the
relationship between the two moving averages over a lookback period.

label: Archer On Balance Volume (AOBV)
description:
Archer On Balance Volume enhances the traditional OBV indicator by applying moving
averages and detecting long/short run trends. It provides multiple signals including
OBV with min/max bounds, fast/slow moving averages of OBV, and trend direction signals.

label: Annualised Historical Volatility (VOLATILITY)
description: Population standard deviation of log-returns annualised by sqrt(252).

label: Bias (BIAS)
description: Rate of change between the source and a moving average.

label: BRAR (BRAR)
description: BR and AR

label: Candle Type: Z
description: Normalizes OHLC Candles with a rolling Z Score.

label: Chandelier Exit (CE)
description:
The Chandelier Exit is a volatility-based trailing stop indicator that uses the
Average True Range (ATR) to determine exit levels. It helps traders stay in a
trend while providing dynamic stop-loss levels based on market volatility.

label: Chande Forcast Oscillator (CFO)
description:
The Forecast Oscillator calculates the percentage difference between the actual
price and the Time Series Forecast (the endpoint of a linear regression line).

label: CPR (Central Pivot Range)
description:
Central Pivot Range is a trending indicator that helps identify potential
support and resistance levels for the trading session based on previous
period's price action.

label: Decay
description:
Creates a decay moving forward from prior signals like crosses. The default is
"linear". Exponential is optional as "exponential" or "exp".

label: Decreasing
description:
Returns True if the series is decreasing over a period, False otherwise.
If the kwarg 'strict' is True, it returns True if it is continuously decreasing
over the period. With 'asint' (the default) it returns 1.0 for True and 0.0
for False as float64, NaN until the compared bars exist.

label: Drawdown (DD)
description:
Drawdown is a peak-to-trough decline during a specific period for an investment,
trading account, or fund. It is usually quoted as the percentage between the
peak and the subsequent trough.

label: Detrended Synthetic Price (DSP)
description:
Detrended Synthetic Price removes the trend component from price data to reveal
the cyclical component. It's useful for cycle analysis and identifying periodic
patterns in price movement.

label: Even Better SineWave (EBSW)
description:
This indicator measures market cycles and uses a low pass filter to remove noise.
Its output is bound signal between -1 and 1 and the maximum length of a detected
trend is limited by its length input.

label: Exponential Decay (EDECAY)
description:
At each bar the value decays multiplicatively from the previous bar,
floored at the current close price.
Formula: result[i] = max(close[i], result[i-1] * exp(-1/length))
tulipy name: EDECAY.

label: Entropy (ENTP)
description:
Introduced by Claude Shannon in 1948, entropy measures the unpredictability
of the data, or equivalently, of its average information. A die has higher
entropy (p=1/6) versus a coin (p=1/2).

label: Fibonacci's Weighted Moving Average (FWMA)
description:
Fibonacci's Weighted Moving Average is similar to a Weighted Moving Average
(WMA) where the weights are based on the Fibonacci Sequence.

label: Gann HiLo Activator(HiLo)
description:
The Gann High Low Activator Indicator was created by Robert Krausz in a 1998
issue of Stocks & Commodities Magazine. It is a moving average based trend
indicator consisting of two different simple moving averages.

label: Historical Volatility (HVOL)
description:
Historical Volatility is the annualized standard deviation of logarithmic
daily returns over a given period. It measures how much the price has varied
historically, expressed as an annualized percentage.

label: HWC (Holt-Winter Channel)
description:
Channel indicator HWC (Holt-Winters Channel) based on HWMA - a three-parameter
moving average calculated by the method of Holt-Winters.

label: HWMA (Holt-Winter Moving Average)
description:
Indicator HWMA (Holt-Winter Moving Average) is a three-parameter moving average
by the Holt-Winter method; the three parameters should be selected to obtain a
forecast.

label: Increasing
description:
Returns True if the series is increasing over a period, False otherwise.
If the kwarg 'strict' is True, it returns True if it is continuously increasing
over the period. With 'asint' (the default) it returns 1.0 for True and 0.0
for False as float64, NaN until the compared bars exist.

label: Inertia (INERTIA)
description:
Inertia was developed by Donald Dorsey and was introduced his article
in September, 1995. It is the Relative Vigor Index smoothed by the Least
Squares Moving Average. Postive Inertia when values are greater than 50,
Negative Inertia otherwise.

label: Jurik Moving Average Average (JMA)
description:
Mark Jurik's Moving Average (JMA) attempts to eliminate noise to see the "true"
underlying activity. It has extremely low lag, is very smooth and is responsive
to market gaps.

label: Log Return
description:
Calculates the logarithmic return of a Series.
See also: help(df.ta.log_return) for additional **kwargs a valid 'df'.

label: Long Run
description:
Identifies potential long (bullish) trend conditions by detecting when the fast 
moving average is increasing while the slow moving average is either decreasing 
(potential bottom) or also increasing (confirmed uptrend).

label: Laguerre RSI (LRSI)
description:
The Laguerre RSI is a modified RSI indicator that uses Laguerre polynomials to
reduce lag and provide earlier signals. It adapts to price changes more quickly
than the standard RSI while maintaining smooth oscillations.

label: Rolling Mean Absolute Deviation
description: Sources:

label: Mean Deviation (MD)
description:
Rolling mean of absolute deviations from the rolling mean.
Equivalent to ta.mad.  tulipy name: MD.

label: Madrid Moving Average Ribbon (MMAR)
description:
The Madrid Moving Average Ribbon is a visual trend indicator that consists of
multiple EMAs with incrementally increasing periods. It helps identify trend
strength and direction through the spacing and alignment of the moving averages.

label: Mesa Sine Wave (MSW)
description:
Introduced by John F. Ehlers in "Rocket Science For Traders" (2001).
Uses a DFT of the recent ``period`` bars to estimate phase and outputs
two oscillators that help identify cycle turning points.

label: Vector Absolute Value (tulipy: ABS)
description:
Calculation:
    ABS = |close|

label: Vector Round (tulipy: ROUND)
description:
Calculation:
    ROUND = close rounded to the nearest integer, halves to even (numpy.round)

label: Price Distance (PDIST)
description: Measures the "distance" covered by price movements.

label: Percent Return
description:
Calculates the percent return of a Series.
See also: help(df.ta.percent_return) for additional **kwargs a valid 'df'.

label: Pretty Good Oscillator (PGO)
description:
The Pretty Good Oscillator indicator was created by Mark Johnson to measure the distance of the current close from its N-day Simple Moving Average, expressed in terms of an average true range over a similar period. Johnson's approach was to
use it as a breakout system for longer term trades. Long if

label: PMAX (Price Max)
description:
PMAX is a trend-following indicator that combines moving averages with ATR
(Average True Range) to create adaptive support and resistance levels. It helps
identify trend direction and potential reversal points.

label: Projection Oscillator (PO)
description:
The Projection Oscillator measures the percentage deviation of price from its
linear regression trend line. It helps identify overbought and oversold conditions
relative to the trend.

label: Psychological Line (PSL)
description:
The Psychological Line is an oscillator-type indicator that compares the
number of the rising periods to the total number of periods. In other
words, it is the percentage of bars that close above the previous
bar over a given period.

label: Price-Volume (PVOL)
description: Returns a series of the product of price and volume.

label: Price Volume Rank
description:
The Price Volume Rank was developed by Anthony J. Macek and is described in his
article in the June, 1994 issue of Technical Analysis of Stocks & Commodities
Magazine. It was developed as a simple indicator that could be calculated even
without a computer. The basic interpretation is to buy when the

label: Pascal's Weighted Moving Average (PWMA)
description:
Pascal's Weighted Moving Average is similar to a symmetric triangular window
except PWMA's weights are based on Pascal's Triangle.

label: Quantitative Qualitative Estimation (QQE)
description: The Quantitative Qualitative Estimation (QQE) is similar to SuperTrend but uses a Smoothed RSI with an upper and lower bands. The band width is a combination of a one period True Range of the Smoothed RSI which is double smoothed using Wilder's smoothing length (2 * rsiLength - 1) and multiplied by

label: Rolling Quantile
description: Sources:

label: Rainbow Charts
description:
Rainbow Charts use multiple moving averages calculated sequentially, where each
MA is calculated on the previous MA rather than the price. This creates a
"rainbow" effect that helps visualize trend strength and potential reversals.

label: Relative Strength Xtra (rsx)
description:
The Relative Strength Xtra is based on the popular RSI indicator and inspired
by the work Jurik Research. The code implemented is based on published code
found at 'prorealcode.com'. This enhanced version of the rsi reduces noise and
provides a clearer, only slightly delayed insight on momentum and v

label: Relative Vigor Index (RVGI)
description:
The Relative Vigor Index attempts to measure the strength of a trend relative to
its closing price to its trading range.  It is based on the belief that it tends
to close higher than they open in uptrends or close lower than they open in
downtrends.

label: Short Run
description:
Identifies potential short (bearish) trend conditions by detecting when the fast 
moving average is decreasing while the slow moving average is either increasing 
(potential top) or also decreasing (confirmed downtrend).

label: Sine Weighted Moving Average (SWMA)
description:
A weighted average using sine cycles. The middle term(s) of the average have the
highest weight(s).

label: Rolling Skew
description: Sources:

label: Slope
description:
Returns the slope of a series of length n. Can convert the slope to angle.
Default: slope.

label: Smart Money Concept Liquidity Sweep (SMC_SWEEP)
description:
Identifies when price sweeps below a swing low (or above a swing high),
violently rejects it, leaving a long wick and closing in the opposite direction.

label: Squeeze (SQZ)
description:
The default is based on John Carter's "TTM Squeeze" indicator, as discussed
in his book "Mastering the Trade" (chapter 11). The Squeeze indicator attempts
to capture the relationship between two studies: Bollinger Bands® and Keltner's
Channels. When the volatility increases, so does the distance bet

label: Squeeze PRO(SQZPRO)
description:
This indicator is an extended version of "TTM Squeeze" from John Carter.
The default is based on John Carter's "TTM Squeeze" indicator, as discussed
in his book "Mastering the Trade" (chapter 11). The Squeeze indicator attempts
to capture the relationship between two studies: Bollinger Bands® and Ke

label: Ehlers' Super Smoother Filter (SSF) © 2013
description:
John F. Ehlers' solution to reduce lag and remove aliasing noise with his
research in aerospace analog filter design. This indicator comes with two
versions determined by the keyword poles. By default, it uses two poles but
there is an option for three poles. Since SSF is a (Resursive) Digital Filte

label: Standard Error (STDERR)
description:
Standard Error is the standard deviation of the sample divided by the square
root of the sample size. It estimates the precision of the sample mean as an
estimate of the population mean.

label: Symmetric Weighted Moving Average (SWMA)
description:
Symmetric Weighted Moving Average where weights are based on a symmetric
triangle.  For example: n=3 -> [1, 2, 1], n=4 -> [1, 2, 2, 1], etc...
This moving average has variable length in contrast to TradingView's fixed
length of 4.

label: TD Sequential (TD_SEQ)
description:
Tom DeMark's Sequential indicator attempts to identify a price point where an
uptrend or a downtrend exhausts itself and reverses.

label: Elders Thermometer (THERMO)
description: Elder's Thermometer measures price volatility.

label: Vector Degrees conversion (tulipy: TODEG). Converts radians to degrees
description:
Calculation:
    TODEG = close * 180 / pi

label: Vector Radians conversion (tulipy: TORAD). Converts degrees to radians
description:
Calculation:
    TORAD = close * pi / 180

label: TRIX Histogram (TRIXH)
description:
TRIX Histogram extends the TRIX indicator by adding a signal line and histogram.
The histogram represents the difference between TRIX and its signal line,
similar to MACD histogram, helping identify momentum changes and divergences.

label: Vector Truncate (tulipy: TRUNC)
description:
Calculation:
    TRUNC = trunc(close), toward zero

label: Ulcer Index (UI)
description:
The Ulcer Index by Peter Martin measures the downside volatility with the use of
the Quadratic Mean, which has the effect of emphasising large drawdowns.

label: Volume Flow Indicator (VFI)
description:
The Volume Flow Indicator (VFI) is a volume-based indicator that helps identify
the strength of bulls vs bears in the market. It combines price movement with
volume to show the flow of money into or out of a security.

label: Volume Oscillator (VOSC)
description:
The Volume Oscillator measures the difference between two volume moving
averages (fast and slow SMAs) as a percentage of the slow SMA.
Rising VOSC indicates increasing volume momentum.

label: Volume Weighted MACD (VWMACD)
description:
Volume Weighted MACD is a variation of the traditional MACD that incorporates
volume into the calculation. It uses Volume Weighted Moving Averages (VWMA)
instead of EMAs to give more weight to periods with higher volume.

label: Rolling Z Score
description: Sources:

label: Abandoned baby bearish
description: D1 white; D2 doji gaps up; D3 black gaps down. Strongest bearish reversal in the star family.

label: Abandoned baby bullish
description: D1 black; D2 doji gaps down (no overlap with D1); D3 white gaps up (no overlap with D2). Strongest bullish reversal in the star family.

label: Above stomach
description: D1 black; D2 white opens within D1 body and closes above D1 midpoint. Bullish reversal.

label: Advance block
description: Three white candles with progressively smaller bodies and/or larger upper shadows – buyers exhausting. Bearish warning.

label: Below stomach
description: D1 white; D2 black opens within D1 body and closes below D1 midpoint. Bearish reversal.

label: Belt hold bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Black candle opening at/near the session high; closes weakly.

label: Belt hold bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). White candle opening at/near the session low; closes strongly.

label: Black candle
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Any close < open candle.

label: Breakaway bearish
description: D1 long white; D2 white (gap up); D3 & D4 small; D5 long black closing back into the gap. Bearish reversal.

label: Breakaway bullish
description: D1 long black; D2 black (gap down from D1); D3 & D4 small/indecisive; D5 long white closing back into the gap (above D2 open, below D1 close). Bullish reversal.

label: Closing marubozu black
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Black candle closing at the low.

label: Closing marubozu white
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). White candle closing at the high.

label: Collapse doji star
description: D1 black; D2 doji near D1 close level; D3 black closes below D1 close. Bearish continuation.

label: Concealing baby swallow
description: D1 & D2 black marubozus; D3 black with a gap-down open and upper shadow that reaches back into D2; D4 black that fully engulfs D3. Bullish reversal.

label: Dark cloud cover
description: D1 long white; D2 black opens above D1 high then closes *penetration* fraction into D1's body (measured downward from D1's close). Parameters ---------- penetration : float, default 0.50 Fraction of D1's body that D2 must close through. 0.50 → D2 closes below the midpoint (classic textbook definitio

label: Deliberation
description: Three white candles; first two strong, third is small/doji-like. Bearish hesitation signal.

label: Doji
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL — returns +1 for shape, 0 otherwise. Body < *threshold* × total range (default 10 %).

label: Doji star bearish
description: D1 white; D2 is a doji that gaps UP above D1's body. Bearish reversal warning (two-bar version).

label: Doji star bullish
description: D1 black; D2 is a doji that gaps DOWN below D1's body. Bullish reversal warning (two-bar version).

label: Downside gap three methods
description: D1 black; D2 black (gap down); D3 white closes inside D1 body. Bearish continuation.

label: Downside tasuki gap
description: D1 & D2 black with a gap down; D3 white opens inside D2 and closes in the gap but does NOT close it. Bearish continuation.

label: Dragonfly doji
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Doji with a long lower shadow and no/tiny upper shadow (T-shape).

label: Engulfing bearish
description: D1 white; D2 black whose body fully engulfs D1's body. Bearish reversal.

label: Engulfing bullish
description: D1 black; D2 white whose body fully engulfs D1's body. Bullish reversal.

label: Evening doji star
description: Like evening_star but D2 is specifically a doji.

label: Evening star
description: D1 long white; D2 small body above D1; D3 black closing below D1 midpoint. Bearish reversal.

label: Falling three methods
description: D1 long black; D2-D4 three small whites within D1's range; D5 long black closing below D1's low. Bearish continuation.

label: Falling window
description: Gap DOWN: current high < prior low. Bearish continuation.

label: Gapping down doji
description: Doji that gaps DOWN from the prior bar (bullish warning in downtrend).

label: Gapping up doji
description: Doji that gaps UP from the prior bar (bearish warning in uptrend).

label: Gravestone doji
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Doji with a long upper shadow and no/tiny lower shadow (inverted T).

label: Hammer
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Small body in the upper portion; lower shadow ≥ shadow_factor × body; tiny upper shadow; typically in a downtrend.

label: Hanging man
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Same shape as hammer but in an uptrend.

label: Harami bearish
description: D1 long white; D2 small black body *inside* D1 body. Bearish reversal: buyers losing conviction.

label: Harami bullish
description: D1 long black; D2 small white body *inside* D1 body. Bullish reversal: sellers losing conviction.

label: Harami cross bearish
description: D1 long white; D2 is a doji whose body is inside D1's body.

label: Harami cross bullish
description: D1 long black; D2 is a doji whose body is inside D1's body.

label: High wave
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL — returns +1 for shape, 0 otherwise. Small real body with very long upper AND lower shadows.

label: Hikkake bearish
description: D1 any; D2 inside bar; D3 closes BELOW D1 low – false upside breakout resolves bearishly.

label: Hikkake bullish
description: D1 any; D2 inside bar (high < D1 high, low > D1 low); D3 closes ABOVE D1 high – false downside breakout resolves bullishly.

label: Homing pigeon
description: Two black candles; D2 body is entirely inside D1 body. Bullish reversal (sellers stalling).

label: Identical three crows
description: Three black crows where each opens at (within *tol* of) the prior close. More bearish than standard three black crows.

label: In neck
description: D1 black; D2 white opens below D1 low and closes very close to D1 close. Bearish continuation – buyers barely made it back.

label: Inverted hammer
description: D1 black (bearish move); D2 has a small body at the bottom of its range with a long upper shadow and tiny/no lower shadow. Bullish reversal.

label: Kicking bearish
description: D1 white marubozu followed by a gap-DOWN black marubozu. Very strong bearish signal.

label: Kicking bullish
description: D1 black marubozu followed by a gap-UP white marubozu. Very strong bullish signal.

label: Ladder bottom
description: D1-D3 three successively lower black candles; D4 black with upper shadow (buyers trying); D5 white opening above D4 close. Bullish reversal.

label: Last engulfing bottom
description: Bullish engulfing in a downtrend (capitulation / bottom reversal).

label: Last engulfing top
description: Bearish engulfing in an uptrend (final gasp / top reversal).

label: Long black day
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0).

label: Long legged doji
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL — returns +1 for shape, 0 otherwise. Doji with significant shadows on BOTH sides.

label: Long white day
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0).

label: Marubozu black
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Black candle with no/negligible shadows.

label: Marubozu white
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). White candle with no/negligible shadows.

label: Mat hold
description: D1 long white; D2 small black (gap up); D3 & D4 small, staying above D1's close; D5 long white closing at a new high vs D2-D4. Bullish continuation.

label: Matching low
description: Two consecutive black candles with the same close (within *tol*). Bullish support signal.

label: Meeting lines bearish
description: D1 white; D2 black opens with a gap up but closes at D1's close level. Bearish reversal.

label: Meeting lines bullish
description: D1 black; D2 white opens with a gap down but closes at D1's close level. Bullish reversal.

label: Morning doji star
description: Like morning_star but D2 is specifically a doji.

label: Morning star
description: D1 long black; D2 small body (any colour) below D1; D3 white closing above D1 midpoint. Bullish reversal.

label: Northern doji
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Doji in an uptrend.

label: On neck
description: D1 black; D2 white opens below D1 low and closes at (within tol of) D1 low. Bearish continuation.

label: Opening marubozu black
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Black candle opening at the high.

label: Opening marubozu white
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). White candle opening at the low.

label: Piercing pattern
description: D1 long black; D2 white opens below D1 low then closes *penetration* fraction into D1's body (measured upward from D1's close). Bullish reversal. Mirror image of dark_cloud_cover. Parameters ---------- penetration : float, default 0.50 0.50 → D2 closes above the midpoint (classic definition). 0.30 →

label: Rickshaw man
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL — returns +1 for shape, 0 otherwise. Long-legged doji with the body near the midpoint of the range.

label: Rising three methods
description: D1 long white; D2-D4 three small blacks staying within D1's range; D5 long white closing above D1's high. Bullish continuation.

label: Rising window
description: Gap UP: current low > prior high. Bullish continuation.

label: Separating lines bearish
description: D1 white; D2 black opens at the same price as D1 (within *tol*). Bearish continuation.

label: Separating lines bullish
description: D1 black; D2 white opens at the same price as D1 (within *tol*). Bullish continuation – buyers defended the open.

label: Shooting star
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Small body near the bottom; long upper shadow ≥ shadow_factor × body; tiny lower shadow; typically in an uptrend.

label: Shooting star two line
description: D1 white (uptrend context); D2 gaps UP then forms a small body near the bottom with a long upper shadow. Bearish reversal.

label: Short black candle
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL — returns +1 for shape, 0 otherwise. Black candle with a small body (< body_thr of range).

label: Short white candle
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL — returns +1 for shape, 0 otherwise. White candle with a small body (< body_thr of range).

label: Side by side white lines bearish
description: D1 black; D2 & D3 are similar-sized white candles with a gap down from D1. Bearish continuation (counter-intuitive).

label: Side by side white lines bullish
description: D1 white; D2 & D3 are similar-sized white candles both opening with a gap up above D1. Bullish continuation.

label: Southern doji
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Doji in a downtrend.

label: Spinning top black
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Black candle with small body and bilateral shadows.

label: Spinning top white
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). White candle with small body and bilateral shadows.

label: Stick sandwich
description: D1 black; D2 white (higher close); D3 black with same close as D1. Bullish reversal (price found support at the matching closes).

label: Takuri line
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Like a hammer but with an unusually long lower shadow (≥ 3× body).

label: Three black crows
description: Three consecutive black candles; each opens inside the prior body and closes progressively lower. Bearish continuation / reversal.

label: Three inside down
description: D1 white; D2 black harami inside D1; D3 black closing below D1 open. Bearish reversal confirmed.

label: Three inside up
description: D1 black; D2 white harami inside D1; D3 white closing above D1 open. Bullish reversal confirmed.

label: Three line strike bearish
description: Three black crows (D1-D3) followed by a white candle (D4) that closes at-or-above D1's open. Bearish continuation signal.

label: Three line strike bullish
description: Three white soldiers (D1-D3) followed by a single black candle (D4) that opens above D3 and closes at-or-below D1's open. Textbook says this is paradoxically a *bullish continuation* signal.

label: Three outside down
description: D1 white; D2 black bearish engulfing; D3 black closing below D2. Bearish reversal confirmed.

label: Three outside up
description: D1 black; D2 white bullish engulfing; D3 white closing above D2. Bullish reversal confirmed.

label: Three stars south
description: Three black candles: each with a lower high and lower low; the third is a small near-marubozu. Bullish reversal.

label: Three white soldiers
description: Three consecutive white candles; each opens inside the prior body and closes progressively higher. Bullish continuation / reversal.

label: Thrusting
description: D1 black; D2 white opens below D1 low and closes between D1 low and D1 midpoint. Weaker than piercing; bearish continuation.

label: Tri star bearish
description: Three consecutive dojis in an uptrend. Bearish reversal.

label: Tri star bullish
description: Three consecutive dojis in a downtrend. Bullish reversal.

label: Tweezer bottoms
description: D1 and D2 share the same low (within *tol* of price). Bullish.

label: Tweezer tops
description: D1 and D2 share the same high (within *tol* of price). Bearish.

label: Two black gapping
description: Two consecutive black candles with a gap DOWN between them. Bearish continuation.

label: Two crows
description: D1 long white; D2 black gaps up into 'star' position; D3 black opens inside D2 body and closes inside D1 body. Bearish reversal.

label: Unique three river bottom
description: D1 long black; D2 black with lower low and long lower shadow; D3 small white closing inside D2 body. Bullish reversal.

label: Upside gap three methods
description: D1 white; D2 white (gap up); D3 black closes inside D1 body. Bullish continuation.

label: Upside gap two crows
description: D1 long white; D2 black gaps up above D1 body; D3 black engulfs D2 but stays above D1 close. Bearish reversal.

label: Upside tasuki gap
description: D1 & D2 white with a gap up; D3 black opens inside D2 and closes in the gap but does NOT close it. Bullish continuation.

label: White candle
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Any close > open candle.

label: Abc correction
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Three-leg pullback within an uptrend: A (high) → B (low) → C (partial bounce below A) → D (entry, higher low than B). Detected using recent pivot extremes.

label: Abcd bear
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). AB=CD bearish: entry at D (price expected to fall).

label: Abcd bull
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). AB=CD bullish: ABCD structure where CD ≈ AB in length. Entry at D (price expected to rise).

label: Ascending triangle
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Flat upper resistance + rising lower support. Confirmed on close above resistance.

label: Bat bear
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bearish bat.

label: Big m
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Like a double top but larger in scale — two major peaks separated by a significant valley, with extra breadth requirements.

label: Big w
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Like a double bottom but larger in scale — two major troughs with a significant peak between them.

label: Broadening bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Expanding price action at a low — broader range with a bullish bias. Confirmed when price closes above the upper trendline.

label: Broadening top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Expanding price action: both trendlines diverging (upper rising, lower falling). Bearish bias.

label: Broadening wedge asc
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Both trendlines rising but diverging (lower rising faster than upper).

label: Broadening wedge desc
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Both trendlines falling but diverging (upper falling faster).

label: Bump and run bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Downward lead-in, steep downward bump, then recovery through lead-in.

label: Bump and run top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Gradual lead-in trendline followed by a steep 'bump' (manic buying), then price collapses back through the lead-in line.

label: Busted asc triangle
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Ascending triangle breaks out upward but quickly reverses back below resistance — bears trapped the bulls.

label: Busted desc triangle
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Descending triangle breaks down but reverses upward — bear trap.

label: Busted double bottom
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Double bottom breaks out bullishly then collapses — bull trap.

label: Busted double top
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Double top breaks down then reverses upward — bear trap.

label: Busted hs bottom
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Inverse H&S breaks above neckline then collapses — bull trap.

label: Busted hs top
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). H&S top breaks below neckline then reverses — bear trap.

label: Busted rectangle
description: BIDIRECTIONAL (+1 or -1). Rectangle breakout fails and reverses — direction depends on which way the original breakout went.

label: Busted sym triangle
description: BIDIRECTIONAL (+1 or -1). Symmetrical triangle breakout reverses — direction is opposite to the initial breakout.

label: Busted triple bottom
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Triple bottom breaks out then collapses.

label: Busted triple top
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Triple top breaks down then reverses.

label: Butterfly bear
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bearish butterfly.

label: Butterfly bull
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Butterfly: AB/XA≈0.786, BC/AB∈[0.382,0.886], CD/BC∈[1.618,2.240], AD/XA∈[1.272,1.618]. D extends beyond X.

label: Carl v
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish V, -1 bearish inverted-V.

label: Carl v bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Price rises sharply, then collapses back to (or below) the starting level within *window* bars — an inverted V.

label: Carl v bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Price drops sharply, then recovers to (or above) the starting level within *window* bars — a completed V recovery.

label: Cat ears
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Two sharp, closely spaced peaks of similar height — like a cat's ears. A tighter, faster version of the double top.

label: Channel asc
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Price trends upward in a parallel channel; bearish when it breaks below the lower channel line (support failure).

label: Channel desc
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Price trends downward in a parallel channel; bullish breakout above the upper channel line.

label: Closing price reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: Closing price reversal bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Downtrend (new *n*-bar low), but closes higher than it opened.

label: Closing price reversal top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Uptrend (new *n*-bar high), but closes lower than it opened.

label: Cloud bank
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Recent closes cluster in a tight band (< *tol* range/mean) — a dense support zone that price is bouncing from.

label: Complex hs bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Complex inverse H&S: multiple shoulders, looser symmetry requirement.

label: Complex hs top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Complex H&S top: multiple shoulders on one or both sides. Detected as two or more H&S patterns sharing the same head.

label: Crab bear
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bearish crab.

label: Cup with handle
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). U-shaped base (cup) followed by a brief pullback (handle). Confirmed when price closes above the cup rim.

label: Dead cat bounce
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). After a sharp decline (≥ *drop_pct* over *window* bars), a weak bounce retraces ≤ *bounce_pct* of the drop — expect resumption of the decline.

label: Dead cat bounce inv
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Sharp rise + shallow pullback — continuation rally expected.

label: Descending triangle
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Flat lower support + descending upper resistance. Confirmed on close below support.

label: Diamond bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Diamond bottom: broadening then contracting at a price low.

label: Diamond top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Broadening formation followed by a symmetrical triangle — creates a diamond shape. First half expands, second half contracts.

label: Diving board
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Price dips sharply for 1-3 bars (diving board shape), then recovers. Signal fires on the recovery bar.

label: Dome shaped volume
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Volume forms an inverted U over *window* bars: rises to a climax peak, then declines. The peak must be at least *peak_pct* of the window from either end (i.e. not at the edges). Signals a distribution / topping phase.

label: Double bottom
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Generic double bottom — any trough shapes. Two pivot lows at approximately the same level (*tol* fraction), separated by at least *min_separation* bars. Parameters ---------- mode : 'forming' | 'confirmed' confirmed — shape + close above the peak between the two troughs.

label: Double bottom adam adam
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Double bottom where both troughs are sharp Adam spikes.

label: Double bottom adam eve
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Double bottom: first trough Adam (sharp), second Eve (rounded).

label: Double bottom eve adam
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Double bottom: first trough Eve, second Adam.

label: Double bottom eve eve
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Double bottom where both troughs are rounded Eve formations.

label: Double key reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Double key reversal bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). 3-bar: D1 up, D2 key reversal down (new high + close < D1 low), D3 confirms.

label: Double key reversal bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Reimports from candlestick module. 3-bar: D1 down, D2 key-reversal up, D3 confirms by closing above D2 close.

label: Double top
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Generic double top — any peak shapes. Two pivot highs at approximately the same level (*tol* fraction), separated by at least *min_separation* bars. Parameters ---------- mode : 'forming' | 'confirmed' forming — shape complete, signal fires continuously. confirmed — shape + close b

label: Double top adam adam
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Double top where both peaks are sharp Adam spikes.

label: Double top adam eve
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Double top: first peak Adam (sharp), second Eve (rounded).

label: Double top eve adam
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Double top: first peak Eve (rounded), second Adam (sharp).

label: Double top eve eve
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Double top where both peaks are rounded Eve formations.

label: Elevator stop
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 when shape fires). Last *window* closes all within *tol* of each other — temporary equilibrium at a support/resistance level.

label: Failure swing
description: BIDIRECTIONAL (+1 bullish / -1 bearish / 0 none). New intrabar extreme but close reverses through bar midpoint — a price-level approximation of the RSI failure swing.

label: Fakey
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Fakey bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Reimports semantics from candlestick hikkake_bearish. Inside bar followed by false upside break that reverses downward.

label: Fakey bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Reimports semantics from candlestick hikkake_bullish. Inside bar followed by false downside break that reverses upward.

label: Falling volume trend
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Volume has been declining consistently over *window* bars. Falling volume during a rally warns of weak buying conviction.

label: Falling wedge
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Both trendlines falling but converging (upper falls faster).

label: Flag high tight
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Very sharp rise (≥ 40 % in ~10 bars) then a tight consolidation (< 20 % retracement). One of Bulkowski's best-performing patterns.

label: Flat base
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Price consolidates in a narrow range (< *max_range_pct* of mean) over *window* bars while in an uptrend — bullish continuation setup.

label: Gap2h
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Current bar opens with a gap up above the prior two bars' highs. Signals strong momentum continuation.

label: Gap2h combined
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish gap2h, -1 bearish inverted.

label: Gap2h inverted
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Current bar opens with a gap down below the prior two bars' lows.

label: Gartley bear
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bearish Gartley: same ratios, inverted structure.

label: Hook reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: Hook reversal bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). D1: down bar (c1 < c0_prior). D2: opens inside D1 range, closes above D1 open. Reimplemented here; semantically equivalent to the candlestick harami + confirm.

label: Hook reversal top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). D1 up bar; D2 opens inside D1 range and closes below D1 open.

label: Horn bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Two spike-lows of similar depth separated by a higher middle bar.

label: Horn top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Two spike-highs of similar height separated by a smaller middle bar.

label: Hs bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Inverse head-and-shoulders: two shoulders above the head (lowest trough). Confirmed when price closes above the neckline.

label: Hs top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Classic head-and-shoulders top: left shoulder (LS), head (H, highest), right shoulder (RS ≈ LS height), neckline through the two troughs. Confirmed when price closes below the neckline.

label: Inside day
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 / 0). Current bar's high-low range is entirely inside the prior bar's range. NON-DIRECTIONAL WARNING: returns +1 for the shape only.

label: Inverted cup with handle
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Inverted U-shaped top followed by a brief bounce (handle). Confirmed when price breaks below the cup base level.

label: Inverted roof
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Inverted arch: dips to a trough then curves back up.

label: Inverted v pivot
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bar makes a sharp new high (new *lookback*-bar high) then collapses — a V-top spike with strong rejection from intraday high.

label: Island bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Price gaps down into island, then gaps up out — bullish reversal.

label: Island top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Price gaps up into an island, trades there, then gaps down below the entry gap — leaving an isolated price island.

label: Key reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: Key reversal bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Bar makes a new *n*-bar low intraday but closes above the prior close. Classic upside key reversal.

label: Key reversal top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bar makes a new *n*-bar high intraday but closes below the prior close. Classic downside key reversal.

label: Key reversal v2
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish v2, -1 bearish v2.

label: Key reversal v2 bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). V2: new *n*-bar high AND closes below prior bar's low (stronger).

label: Key reversal v2 bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). V2: new *n*-bar low AND closes above prior bar's high (stronger).

label: Long island
description: BIDIRECTIONAL (+1 or -1). Like island reversal but spanning several days. Direction depends on whether price exited via a gap up (+1) or gap down (-1).

label: Measured move down
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Two downward legs of approximately equal size separated by a bounce.

label: Measured move up
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Two upward legs of approximately equal length separated by a correction. Signal at the start of the second leg (or at completion).

label: Mountain
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Price forms a mountain: rises sharply then falls sharply back to (or below) the starting level.

label: Narrow range 4
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 / 0). Current bar has the narrowest high-low range of the last 4 bars. Signals a volatility contraction — breakout expected. NON-DIRECTIONAL WARNING: returns +1 for the shape only.

label: Narrow range 7
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 / 0). Current bar has the narrowest range of the last 7 bars. Stronger squeeze signal than NR4. NON-DIRECTIONAL WARNING: returns +1 for the shape only.

label: One day reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: One day reversal bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Single bar that makes a new *n*-bar low but closes above the midpoint of its own range (strong recovery within the session).

label: One day reversal top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Single bar: new *n*-bar high but closes below the midpoint of its range.

label: One two three
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: One two three bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Downtrend followed by: point-1 (low), point-2 (bounce high), point-3 (higher low > point-1), then price breaks above point-2. Signal fires at the point-2 breakout bar.

label: One two three top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Uptrend followed by: point-1 (high), point-2 (pullback low), point-3 (lower high < point-1), then price breaks below point-2.

label: Open close reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: Open close reversal bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). D1 closes near its low; D2 opens lower but closes above D1 close.

label: Open close reversal top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). D1 closes near its high; D2 opens higher but closes below D1 close.

label: Outside day
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish outside day, -1 bearish.

label: Outside day bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Outside day with a bearish close (c < prior low).

label: Outside day bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Outside day (range engulfs prior) with a bullish close (c > prior high).

label: Partial decline
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Within a consolidation, price dips toward support but fails to reach it — often precedes an upside breakout.

label: Partial rise
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Within a consolidation pattern (triangle/rectangle), price makes a partial rise toward resistance but fails to reach it — often precedes a downside breakout.

label: Pipe bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Two adjacent candles with similar deep lows — capitulation at the bottom.

label: Pipe top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Two adjacent candles with similar tall highs — exhaustion at the top.

label: Pivot point reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: Pivot point reversal bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). D1 is a down bar; D2 gaps up (opens above D1 high) and closes higher.

label: Pivot point reversal top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). D1 is an up bar; D2 gaps down (opens below D1 low) and closes lower.

label: Pothole
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). A pothole is a brief downward retrace (a "pothole in the road") that digs below a recent flat base of support for 1-3 bars and then recovers, with price closing back at or above the base. Per Bulkowski it is a bullish continuation pattern within an upward trend, not a bearish one.

label: Rectangle bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Flat support and resistance; upside breakout after an uptrend context.

label: Rectangle top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Price oscillates between flat support and flat resistance; breakout expected downward (bearish context = downtrend before the rectangle).

label: Right angle broadening asc
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Flat upper resistance + falling lower support (right-angled, ascending bias from lows while highs are flat → bearish resolution).

label: Right angle broadening desc
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Flat lower support + rising upper resistance.

label: Rising volume trend
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Volume has been rising consistently over *window* bars. A rising volume trend confirms upward price moves. *min_slope_pct* is the minimum slope as a fraction of mean volume.

label: Rising wedge
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Both trendlines rising but converging (lower rises faster → support approaching resistance).

label: Roof
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Arched price action: rises to a peak then curves back down. Similar to rounding top but over a shorter timeframe.

label: Rounding bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Gradual U-shaped price curve over *window* bars. Detected by checking that the middle third of the window has lower closes than the outer thirds.

label: Rounding top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Gradual inverted-U price curve.

label: Scallop asc
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Repeated J-shaped recovery (scallop) in a rising trend.

label: Scallop asc inv
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Inverted ascending scallop — ∩-shape in a rising trend signals a top.

label: Scallop desc
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Inverted J-shape (decay) in a falling trend.

label: Scallop desc inv
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). J-shaped recovery in a falling trend — potential bottom reversal.

label: Shark 32
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 / 0). Bar 3 is an inside bar of bar 2, which is an inside bar of bar 1. Three consecutive inside bars signal extreme compression. NON-DIRECTIONAL WARNING: direction of breakout is not predicted.

label: Spikes
description: BIDIRECTIONAL (+1 lower spike / -1 upper spike / 0 none). Upper spike (bearish): upper wick ≥ shadow_factor × body. Lower spike (bullish): lower wick ≥ shadow_factor × body.

label: Symmetrical triangle
description: BIDIRECTIONAL (+1 bullish breakout / -1 bearish / 0 none). Both trendlines converging; direction determined by confirmed breakout.

label: Three bar
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Three bar bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Three-bar pattern: up bar, inside bar, down bar closing below D1 open.

label: Three bar bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Three-bar pattern: down bar, inside or narrow bar, up bar closing above D1 open.

label: Three day compression
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 / 0). Each of the three bars has a total range less than *factor* × the range of the bar 3 bars prior. Signals a volatility squeeze. NON-DIRECTIONAL WARNING: returns +1 for the shape — provides no inherent price direction. Use with other context.

label: Three dc
description: Alias for :func:`three_day_compression`.

label: Three lr
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Three lr bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Three consecutive higher highs (3 legs up) followed by a lower close.

label: Three lr bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Three consecutive lower lows (3 legs down) followed by a higher close.

label: Three lr inverted bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Inverted 3L-R: three lower highs (ceiling pressing down) + down close.

label: Three lr inverted bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Inverted 3L-R: three higher lows (hammering the floor) + up close.

label: Three peaks
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Three successive pivot highs each lower than the last — a stair-step distribution pattern with bearish bias.

label: Three peaks domed house
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bulkowski's 'three peaks and a domed house': three peaks followed by a broad rounded dome top before a major decline. Approximated here as three rising peaks (the 'house' stage) then a rounded reversal. .. note:: Full Bulkowski pattern spans months; this implementation detects the

label: Three valleys
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Three successive pivot lows each higher than the last — a stair-step accumulation pattern with bullish bias.

label: Triple bottom
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Three pivot lows at approximately equal prices, confirmed by a close above the highest peak between the three troughs.

label: Triple top
menu: Double and multiple tops and bottoms
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Three pivot highs at approximately equal prices, each separated by at least *min_separation* bars, confirmed by a close below the lowest valley between the three peaks.

label: Turn key
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Turn key bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). 3 white candles then a wide black bar closing below D1 open.

label: Turn key bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). 3 black candles (lower lows) then a wide white bar closing above D1 open. Reimports from candlestick multi_bar.three_line_strike_bullish semantics.

label: Two b
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bottom, -1 top.

label: Two b bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Price makes a new low, then the very next close recovers above the prior swing low, signalling a failed breakdown.

label: Two b top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Price makes a new high, then the very next close is below the prior swing high within *lookback* bars, signalling a failed breakout.

label: Two close
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Two close bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). D1 is an up bar (c1 > o1). D2 closes below D1's open.

label: Two close bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). D1 is a down bar (c1 < o1). D2 closes above D1's open.

label: Two dance
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish setup, -1 bearish setup.

label: Two dance bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Two bars with similar closes, second bar black — consolidation at resistance.

label: Two dance bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Two bars with similar closes (within tol), second bar white. Price consolidates at support before continuing up.

label: Two did
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Two did bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). D2 closes below D1 close (D1 was an up bar) — sellers absorb buying.

label: Two did bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). D2 closes above D1 close (D1 was a down bar) — buyers absorb selling.

label: Two step
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Two step bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). 5-bar pattern: big up move (D1), partial pullback (D2-D4), resumption down (D5).

label: Two step bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). 5-bar pattern: big down move (D1), partial bounce (D2-D4), resumption up (D5). Similar to breakaway_bullish from candlestick module.

label: Two tall
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 bullish, -1 bearish.

label: Two tall bearish
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). D2 is a tall black bar, significantly larger than D1 body.

label: Two tall bullish
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). D2 is a tall (large body) white bar, significantly larger than D1 body.

label: U shaped volume
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Volume forms a U over *window* bars: declines to a trough then recovers. Signals a base-building / accumulation phase.

label: V bottom
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Sharp decline then equally sharp recovery — a V-shape.

label: V bottom extended
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Like a V-bottom but the right side overshoots the starting price — extended recovery signals continued buying.

label: V pivot
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Bar makes a sharp new low (new *lookback*-bar low) with a small body — a V-reversal spike. High recovery from intraday low.

label: V top
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Sharp rise then sharp fall — inverted V.

label: V top extended
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Extended inverted V: recovery from initial top extends to new lows.

label: Vertical run down
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). *n* consecutive bars each closing in the lower *close_pct* of their range.

label: Vertical run up
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). *n* consecutive bars each closing in the upper *close_pct* fraction of their range — nearly vertical price climb.

label: Volume breakout day
description: NON-DIRECTIONAL (+1 / 0). Current bar's volume exceeds *vol_factor* × the average volume of the prior *lookback* bars, AND the bar closes more than 1 % above or below its open. Signals a high-conviction directional move. NON-DIRECTIONAL WARNING: the +1 flag fires regardless of which direction the br

label: Weekly reversal
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 upside, -1 downside.

label: Weekly reversal downside
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). New *lookback*-bar high intraday but closes below prior close and open.

label: Weekly reversal upside
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Bar makes a new *lookback*-bar low intraday but closes above the prior bar's close AND above the current open. Applied on any timeframe.

label: Wide ranging day
description: BIDIRECTIONAL: +1 upside reversal, -1 downside reversal.

label: Wide ranging day down
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Wide-range bar closing in its lower half.

label: Wide ranging day up
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Bar with a very wide range (> factor × average) closing in its upper half.

label: Wolfe wave bear
description: BEARISH (-1 / 0). Bearish Wolfe Wave: 1,3,5 are highs and 2,4 are lows. Point 5 overshoots the 1-3 trendline; entry when price falls back below it.

label: Wolfe wave bull
description: BULLISH (+1 / 0). Bullish Wolfe Wave: 5-pivot pattern where points 1,3,5 are lows and 2,4 are highs. Point 5 undershoots the 1-3 trendline; entry at point 5 when price crosses above it.

label: A line some bars ago
description: The input's value that many bars back. History only: it never moves a value forward.

label: Bars since a signal
description: How many bars ago the input was last non-zero, such as a pattern firing. Blank before the first time.

label: Distance between two lines (%)
description: How far line a is above line b, as a percentage of b: (a / b - 1) x 100.

label: Moving average envelope
description: A moving average with bands a fixed percentage above and below it.

label: Offset a line by a percentage
description: The line times (1 + percent / 100). Use a negative percent to go below it.

label: Band a percentage around a line
description: Two lines, percent above and percent below the input. 'Within 5% of the EMA' is a price between the lower and upper lines of a 5% band around the EMA.

label: Previous day, week or month
description: The last completed day's (week's, month's) open, high, low and close, held until the next one completes. It never shows a period that is still forming.

label: Python code
description: Trusted local code. The function body receives open, high, low, close, volume, np and pd, and returns a frame shaped like close.
